scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Quadratic Strong-Operator Paving over Arbitrary Maximal Abelian Subalgebras” (preprints/Quadratic-Strong-Operator-Paving-over-Arbitrary-Maximal-Abelian-Subalgebras-September-25-2026/Quadratic-Strong-Operator-Paving-over-Arbitrary-Maximal-Abelian-Subalgebras-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 300 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d0cda0544b3c1b1b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every 0 < ε < 1, set rε = l 400000000ε−2 m + ⌈4/ε⌉ + 1 ≤ 500000000ε−2 . For every masa A ⊆ M ⊆ B(H) and every x = x∗ ∈ M, the element x is (ε, rε) so-pavable over A. In particular, the number of projections is fixed before the inclusion, operator, and strong neighborhood. No separability or conditional-expectation assumption is imposed on the inclusion.
